newsitem.title: USA: Mountain Province stake held by DDJ group.
newsitem.headline: Mountain Province stake held by DDJ group.

text.p: A group led by DDJ Capital Management LLC said it holds a 12.33 percent stake in Mountain Province Mining Inc or 2,668,000 common shares.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 218,700 common shares between Nov 7 and Dec 2. However, it did not give a price per share breakdown.
The entire stake in the Canadian diamond explorer was purchased for cash for about $12,652,519.02, DDJ said.
The shares were purchased in order to acquire an equity interest in the company in pursuit of specified investment objectives established by the investors in the fund, the group said in the filing.
DDJ said it intends to "review continuously the equity position of the funds in the company."
